title: Refined Vanilla
description: Refined Vanilla massively boosts your game with performance, visual, and quality-of-life upgrades for the ultimate vanilla experience. This is a fully client-side modpack, enhancing your game without altering its core.
body:
# **Refined Vanilla: The Definitive Vanilla Experience**
Tired of the vanilla experience but don't want to alter the core gameplay you love? Refined Vanilla is designed for you. This pack is a carefully curated collection of fully client-side mods and resources, built to enhance every aspect of your adventure by focusing on three key pillars: performance, visuals, and quality-of-life.

The goal isn't to change Minecraft, but to refine it—making it the game it always could have been: faster, more beautiful, and smarter.

## Key Features:
**Unmatched Performance:** Optimized to run as smoothly as possible. It includes essential, industry-standard mods like Sodium, Lithium, and Entity Culling to deliver the highest and most stable FPS, even on modest hardware.

**Stunning Visuals:** The world comes alive with fresh textures that modernize the classic aesthetic, fluid animations for the player, mobs, and the environment, and a curated selection of pre-configured shaderpacks to completely transform your world's lighting, shadows, and water.

**Quality of Life (QoL) Enhancements:** Enjoy a more pleasant gameplay loop with small but impactful tweaks, like a cleaner HUD, and robust improvements for organizing both your inventory and chests, making the experience more intuitive and efficient.

**Fully Client-Side & A Perfect Foundation:** Built entirely with client-side mods, Refined Vanilla adds no new blocks or items and makes no changes to core mechanics. This not only ensures compatibility with vanilla servers but also makes it the perfect, stable foundation for you to build upon. Add your own content mods (tech, magic, etc.) to create your dream modpack with performance already handled.
